title: Sky
caption: The theme selects the light; clouds carry the wind
intro: Switch the site theme to compare the sun and crescent moon. The second specimen forces a moon independently of the surrounding theme. The clouds show the default Surface arrangement.
contract: Import SunMoon and Clouds from slide-shared/iceberg/scenery/sky. Both lights are server-rendered and CSS selects day or night. Cloud placements accept x, y, scale and shape. Wind is the Surface's ambient loop; the gallery pause control also stops it.

variants.theme: Sun or moon, selected by the site theme
variants.clouds: Surface clouds, drifting in the wind
